definitions.gloss: penne; short tube pasta cut at an angle
definitions.explanation: Short cylindrical pasta with the ends cut diagonally, so that sauce catches inside the tube. From Italian penne (quills).

examples.japanese: ペンネのアラビアータが{好|す}きだ。
ペンネはソースがよくからむ。
グラタンに{使|つか}うなら、{細|ほそ}いパスタよりペンネのほうが{食|た}べやすい。
examples.english: If you're making gratin, penne is easier to eat than thin pasta.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ペンネアラビアータ: penne all'arrabbiata (spicy tomato sauce)
- ペンネをゆでる: to boil penne
- ペンネのグラタン: penne gratin

SIMILAR WORDS:
- パスタ: pasta — the general term
- マカロニ: macaroni — shorter, curved, with straight-cut ends
- スパゲッティ: spaghetti — long and thin rather than short and tubular
